title: OmegaPack
description: Minecraft modpack with various optimisation and QOL mods
body:
This Minecraft modpack is designed to **provide a smoother, more enjoyable gameplay experience.**
It includes a carefully selected set of **optimization mods to improve performance, reduce lag, and ensure better stability** on a wide range of systems.

The modpack also features many **Quality of Life (QOL) mods that enhance everyday gameplay** without changing the core Minecraft experience. These improvements make the game more comfortable, intuitive, and enjoyable to play.
In addition, several utility mods are included to offer practical tools and helpful features for both casual and advanced players.
- ✔ Optimized performance
- ✔ Improved gameplay comfort
- ✔ Useful and practical tools
- ✔ Vanilla-friendly experience
Perfect for players who want Minecraft to run better while staying simple and efficient.
